title: The Blackout
prompt: A woman at work is going downstairs when suddenly there is a blackout. At that very moment she realizes her husband is about to die.
solution: The woman worked as an electrician at a hospital and she knew that the emergency generators were broken. Her husband had been in a car crash and was in that hospital, connected to a machine that kept him alive. When the blackout happened she knew he could not breathe on his own and was dying.
